scorer: Operator adjudication (Claude Opus 5.5) of scorers A and B before unblinding; img11 and img17 disputes resolved from both notes.

scores.notes: Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Decorative style: centre (x~460-900, y~80-640) is a throne of eyed wheels and wings around a dome of flame with no face, hands or robe; cloud and flame reach all four edges and there are no marks in the corners.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon/gold-ground style: Moses crouches in a stone cleft at centre with his staff beside him; the upper sky shows only a band of fire streaming through grey cloud, and no hand or figure. The gold sky top-left and the landscape reach every edge.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Realistic oil: the summit at top centre shows only fire, black smoke and lightning, with no face or silhouette; Israelites bow and shield their heads in the foreground. Fully painted to all edges and no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Realistic oil: light and cloud pour from the gold inner shrine (top centre-right) with no figure inside; Isaiah looks up at left, linen-clad priests bow at both sides, and an altar burns. The wall carvings of cherubim are architectural reliefs. Painted to all edges.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolour/ink: an empty throne of flame lines (centre, x~640-900, y~90-420) above a row of burning wheels in turbulent cloud. The white patches at the side edges are reserved cloud highlights with ink lines running off the edge, not an unpainted margin.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon style, pillarboxed: blank gold-leaf bands about 300px wide fill the left and right sides, and the painted landscape ends at hard vertical seams near x~300 and x~1075. The tablets Moses holds (x~590-700, y~215-310) carry rows of pseudo-script glyphs; the cloud has no figure.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon style: the throne in the blue heaven at top centre is empty apart from a glowing oval, with four winged creatures on wheels below. Small gold pseudo-letter marks are painted on the ground right of Ezekiel's foot (x~430-460, y~665 and x~560-610, y~655-680).

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolour/ink: the throne at top centre (x~760-990, y~30-215) holds a seated robed figure of white light, with lap, knees and drapery visible and arms on the armrests. Ezekiel, the river and the four creatures are otherwise correct; painted to all edges.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolour/ink: the sky wash stops short of the left edge (y~60-260) and the right edge (y~140-250), leaving ragged white paper. The tablets at centre (x~750-870, y~180-290) are covered with rows of pseudo-script; the surrounding cloud has no figure.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Realistic oil: the cloud just left of and above Moses (x~640-780, y~70-330) holds a ghostly face with eyes, nose, beard and hair over a flowing robed body. The tablets show only faint illegible streaks; painted to all edges.

Operator: a painted gilt border on all four sides is a frame, which rule 2 forbids; flawed. A: A gilt painted border runs around all four sides as part of the artwork. Inside, Isaiah stands before cloud and light pouring from open shrine doors, with no figure in the light; attendants bow at both sides.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolour/ink: the cloud pillar at the tabernacle entrance (top centre) is scalloped cloud with a warm glow and no figure; Aaron and Miriam step forward, Moses stands with his staff, and onlookers stand among the tents. Painted to all edges with no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon style with a gilt border band around all four sides. The cloud pillar at the tabernacle door shows only a vertical light shaft, but Moses (right of centre) grips two separate staffs, one in each hand, a duplicated prop.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Painterly oil: an empty throne of flame on burning wheels at centre, ringed by swirling fire and cloud; no figure in the throne or the flames. Painted to all edges with no marks.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon style: Sinai at centre crowned with red-and-blue smoke and flame against a gold and storm sky, with no figure in the smoke. Israelites bow and shield their eyes before the tents; the gold sky and ground reach every edge.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon style: the throne at top centre is empty and blazing with light under a rainbow; John kneels on rocks seen from behind, before a sea in a hall. A small fire burns on a rooftop at top right. Painted to all edges.

Operator: margin agreed by both; the tiny pencil mark is counted as initials, conservatively. B: Watercolour/ink: the left edge shows white unpainted paper where the wall wash stops short (y~220-480), and the bottom-left corner fades to paper. A tiny pencil mark resembling initials ('/o') sits on a floor line at bottom-left (x~40-75, y~740-755). The smoke and light around the altar have no figure.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolour/ink: the bottom-left corner (x~0-40, y~600-768) is cream unpainted paper behind a ragged wash boundary. The swirling fire-cloud in the upper right has no figure; Moses crouches praying in the rock cleft with his staff beside him.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Painterly oil: at top centre (x~705-880, y~0-160) a robed figure sits on the throne in golden cloud, with draped knees and hands on the armrests. Ezekiel writes on the riverbank below four winged lion creatures on wheels.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolour/ink: Sinai at centre erupts with fire, smoke and lightning, with no face or figure in the smoke; Israelites bow, kneel and cover their faces in the foreground. Painted to all edges.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Realistic oil: inside the cloud pillar left of the tabernacle (x~555-600, y~255-335) a small luminous standing figure with a round head and vertical robed body sits within a mandorla-shaped glow. The pillar also stands beside the tent rather than at its door.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Realistic oil: the glory at the top centre-right is fire-lit cloud over the summit with no figure. Moses sits against a rock face with arms folded and his staff beside him, on an open slope rather than pressed into a narrow cleft. Painted to all edges.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Realistic oil: the throne at centre is a column of light under a rainbow with no figure, but both sides (x~0-240 and x~1100-1376, y~220-540) are packed with unselected crowned elders, winged angels and horned beasts bowing. John kneels in the foreground.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolour/ink: an empty throne engulfed in flame and cloud under a rainbow at centre, with John kneeling, seen from behind, on a glass floor. The pale edges are light washes with ink lines running off every border, not bare paper.
